fact_text: The analyst said the KSE-100 was around 173,800 at the end of 2025, after a very strong rise in the index.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 29 Dec 2025 | KSE-100 Target 175,000 by End25 | Nishat Power Top Pick  PTCL Merger Play' (YouTube, 2025-12-29)

fact_text: The analyst put about 175,000 forward as a possible KSE-100 level by the end of 2025, as a projection rather than a stock-specific call.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 29 Dec 2025 | KSE-100 Target 175,000 by End25 | Nishat Power Top Pick  PTCL Merger Play' (YouTube, 2025-12-29)

fact_text: The analyst says the 2025 index rise was led by heavy-weight stocks such as Fauji Fertilizer, PTC, OGDC and Pakistan Petroleum, plus some banks.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 29 Dec 2025 | KSE-100 Target 175,000 by End25 | Nishat Power Top Pick  PTCL Merger Play' (YouTube, 2025-12-29)

fact_text: The analyst says many investors earned less than the index because the gains sat in heavy-weight stocks and some banks that many clients do not hold.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 29 Dec 2025 | KSE-100 Target 175,000 by End25 | Nishat Power Top Pick  PTCL Merger Play' (YouTube, 2025-12-29)

fact_text: The analyst's reasoning is that a portfolio should hold quality stocks with dividends and good management, not only the heavy-weight stocks that drove the index.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 29 Dec 2025 | KSE-100 Target 175,000 by End25 | Nishat Power Top Pick  PTCL Merger Play' (YouTube, 2025-12-29)

fact_text: The PIA Holding privatisation dispute is settled, and the winning consortium's earnest money of PKR 10.2 billion went to the government.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 29 Dec 2025 | KSE-100 Target 175,000 by End25 | Nishat Power Top Pick  PTCL Merger Play' (YouTube, 2025-12-29)

fact_text: The analyst says PIA Holding carries very large debt against a small equity base, which limits his enthusiasm for investing in it.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 29 Dec 2025 | KSE-100 Target 175,000 by End25 | Nishat Power Top Pick  PTCL Merger Play' (YouTube, 2025-12-29)

fact_text: Telenor Pakistan and PTC are expected to be amalgamated in 2026, with the combined mobile market share at around 37-38%, according to the analyst.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 29 Dec 2025 | KSE-100 Target 175,000 by End25 | Nishat Power Top Pick  PTCL Merger Play' (YouTube, 2025-12-29)

fact_text: The analyst expects the 2026 accounts to consolidate Telenor's revenues into PTC, which he sees as a key factor for PTC after the merger.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 29 Dec 2025 | KSE-100 Target 175,000 by End25 | Nishat Power Top Pick  PTCL Merger Play' (YouTube, 2025-12-29)

fact_text: According to the analyst, PTC's broadband revenue is around PKR 40-50 billion, which makes broadband a large part of its business.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 29 Dec 2025 | KSE-100 Target 175,000 by End25 | Nishat Power Top Pick  PTCL Merger Play' (YouTube, 2025-12-29)

fact_text: The analyst regards the recent 5G spectrum offering as important for PTC because of the options it opens for the company.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 29 Dec 2025 | KSE-100 Target 175,000 by End25 | Nishat Power Top Pick  PTCL Merger Play' (YouTube, 2025-12-29)

fact_text: The analyst cites a transaction valued at about PKR 65 billion linked to Rafhan Maize, which appeared in company notices.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 29 Dec 2025 | KSE-100 Target 175,000 by End25 | Nishat Power Top Pick  PTCL Merger Play' (YouTube, 2025-12-29)

fact_text: The analyst says Nishat Power has about a 14% share linked to the Rafhan Maize transaction, making it the main beneficiary he identifies.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 29 Dec 2025 | KSE-100 Target 175,000 by End25 | Nishat Power Top Pick  PTCL Merger Play' (YouTube, 2025-12-29)

fact_text: The analyst expects Nishat Power to gain most from the Rafhan-linked development, citing its own power purchase policy dating from 2002.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 29 Dec 2025 | KSE-100 Target 175,000 by End25 | Nishat Power Top Pick  PTCL Merger Play' (YouTube, 2025-12-29)

fact_text: The analyst expects investors to see fourth-quarter earnings and dividends from banks such as Habib Bank and HMB, which he regards as in good shape.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 29 Dec 2025 | KSE-100 Target 175,000 by End25 | Nishat Power Top Pick  PTCL Merger Play' (YouTube, 2025-12-29)

fact_text: Notices cited in the video said Rafhan Maize's contribution would bring it a 32.71% stake in D.G. Khan Cement.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 29 Dec 2025 | KSE-100 Target 175,000 by End25 | Nishat Power Top Pick  PTCL Merger Play' (YouTube, 2025-12-29)
